content: A 2026-08-16 USPTO official all-status wordmark search for LINECLEAR returned zero records. EUIPO-coordinated TMview exact-name search returned three records: registered Republic of Korea Class 9, ended Republic of Korea Classes 3/35, and registered Malaysia Class 39; TMview warns it is not an official register and has no legal effect, so office-level verification is required. WIPO Global Brand Database presented a CAPTCHA and Brazil INPI was in maintenance, preventing reproducible independent result exports. This is a preliminary knockout search, not legal clearance.
